scientific_budget_source: Complete original parameter file and direct finite-phase scientific program.
scientific_protocol: Optimize the physical embedding by both true annular geodesic families, curvature, Jacobi value and derivative, length, rim landing and material angular increment. Include all three annular variation components and finite nonlinear cap/central controls with their actual side-specific coordinates. Fit the two material chart changes on the independent shooting tables, then evaluate the resulting actual physical pullback at all fixed-metric time and spatial samples. Evaluate the last complete point on the same worker and export the independent closed mesh and geometry records. Keep numerical guards and regularization visible in the actual return.
canonical_point_words: Keep the original physical knot matrix, both fitted material-map arrays, exact phase knots and each complete stage NPZ with their independent original digests. The closed-point SHA binds the physical, material-map and phase identities plus the stage design and configuration. The seven world PLY meshes carry this full closed-point identity.

direct_input_lineage.fixed_parent_files: R740/742/744/746/747/748/752/753 physical geometry with the original Run39 profile nodes, Run40 physical operations and Run41 field and basis module. The complete trigger tree freezes every input byte.
direct_input_lineage.scientific_observations: The run creates its own five full initial candidates and accepts its own fixed R752 target. It requires no earlier optimization result or saved runner field.

physics.shape: Full nineteen admitted central and cap parameters, both complete independent three-vector annular fields and the two endpoint fractional powers.

scientific_parameter_summary.solver: L-BFGS-B with maxls=24, maxcor=15, ftol=2e-12, gtol=2e-8; all phase-zero and positive-time coordinates retained. The independent check uses RK4 on the complete union of physical nodes and its specified steps.
scientific_parameter_summary.closure: 65 final fixed-metric time checks plus all seven listed world mesh phases; finite comparisons use their union, including any noncoincident export angles. No wall-clock convergence predicate.

output_contract.scientific_summary: Exact original summary.json and immutable per-stage stage-NN-return.json are distinct small scientific documents. The terminal index for the same selected point is published as its independent original JSON document.
output_contract.raw_fields: Every complete raw coefficient and fitted map NPZ, deterministic full PLY.GZ, and per-phase detailed geometry stays on this public job worker. Publish record identities and finite scalar measurements in their natural scientific documents.
output_contract.public_attempt: notes/run42-bent-fermi-phase-<run>-<attempt>.json, its independent summary/physical-stage/geometry-index siblings, and one handoff marker. All are carried by one checked ordinary push on the latest checked remote main.
output_contract.interpretation: Finite-grid returns, numerical guard activity and midpoint training and independent RK4 checks are recorded as measurements. Uniform metric closure, global embedding and regularized independent bounds still require proof.
